title: The First Verbs
label: ch:first-verbs
canDo: I can build short present-tense French sentences with the chapter's first verbs.

payoff.summary: Until now you have assembled fixed phrases. This chapter hands you a pattern instead: the regular -er verbs, the largest verb family in French by a wide margin. Learn the one template and thousands of verbs come with it — and with it you build your first sentence that nobody handed you pre-made.
payoff.note: Chapter 5 is schema-v2 as of the handwritten-chapter retirement, so the payoff is atom-scored: FR-C05-practice assesses every atom the chapter introduces.
